dfm.description: Load bundled manufacturer profiles, run DFM checks, and estimate cost.
dfm.fallbackPolicy: Run deterministic local manufacturer-rule checks on parsed design data.

emc.description: Run lightweight EMC-oriented layout checks and a bundled compliance sweep.
emc.fallbackPolicy: Apply explicit, reviewable design changes without hidden native API fallback.

export.description: Produce low-level debug, review, and interchange exports.
export.fallbackPolicy: Require a verified kicad-cli capability; never silently emulate native exports.

library.description: Search and inspect symbol/footprint libraries plus live component data.
library.fallbackPolicy: Use local KiCad libraries first; network enrichment is explicit and optional.

manufacturing.description: Panelization, bring-up test plan generation, and release manifest.
manufacturing.fallbackPolicy: Use CLI for native import/export and validated local transforms for metadata.

pcb_read.description: Read PCB state including tracks, vias, footprints, nets, and layers.
pcb_read.fallbackPolicy: Prefer official IPC. File-backed parsers are permitted only for tools whose capability record does not require IPC.

pcb_write.description: Modify PCB geometry, sync initial footprints, and save board changes.
pcb_write.fallbackPolicy: Fail closed when an IPC-required mutation has no live backend. Explicit file-backed mutations use atomic replacement and post-write parsing.

power_integrity.description: Estimate voltage drop, current capacity, decoupling needs, power planes, and thermal spreading.
power_integrity.fallbackPolicy: Use deterministic analytical models and explicit design-file writes.

project.description: Project setup, server discovery, and quick help.
project.fallbackPolicy: Use repository and filesystem discovery; use KiCad CLI only for native probes.

release_export.fallbackPolicy: Require KiCad CLI, release evidence, and the existing human approval gate.

routing.description: Advanced routing helpers including FreeRouting orchestration and rule-file tuning.
routing.fallbackPolicy: External routing is explicit; session application uses validated transactional writes.

schematic.description: Inspect and edit schematic files with hybrid IPC reload support.
schematic.fallbackPolicy: Use IPC when required; otherwise use the transactional schematic writer with structural fingerprint loss detection and opportunistic IPC reload.

signal_integrity.description: Estimate impedance, skew, length matching, stackup geometry, via stubs, and decoupling placement.
signal_integrity.fallbackPolicy: Use deterministic analytical models and label results as advisory.

simulation.description: SPICE analysis, model assignment, and library management.
simulation.fallbackPolicy: Require ngspice for simulation; analytical substitutes must be separate tools.

validation.description: Design validation, DFM checks, and rule inspection.
validation.fallbackPolicy: Prefer native DRC/ERC; local checks must identify themselves as advisory.

version_control.description: Create Git checkpoints, inspect diffs, and safely restore project files.
version_control.fallbackPolicy: Use isolated Git commands with hooks disabled and explicit confirmation for release tags.
